summary: Project with a Vault UI featuring a sidebar and NFT preview page. Working on adding scrolling to the Vault sidebar and NFT preview page without changing the existing design.
architectural_notes: Vault UI has a sidebar and NFT preview page; scroll behavior should be added without altering layout or styling

new_feature_requests.summary: Add scrolling to the Vault sidebar and NFT preview page so users can view all content without changing the current Vault design

Add vertical scrolling to the Vault sidebar so that all sidebar content (layers, filters, controls) is accessible when it overflows the viewport height, without altering any existing sidebar styling, layout, or visual design.

Add vertical scrolling to the NFT preview panel/page within the Vault so that all NFT preview content (image, metadata, traits) is accessible when it overflows the available height, without altering any existing preview panel styling, layout, or visual design.
